provenance.basis: Saved Nextwise artifacts, local H-MEM implementation and validation report, and the user's reported Zetaris connection test. No private project implementation inspected.
provenance.hash_scope: Exact file bytes; hashes establish artifact identity, not independent verification.

confirmed_project_context.name: AI Raw Gourmet
confirmed_project_context.purpose: Generate and adapt recipes and meal plans to user constraints.

investigated_task.description: Extract explicitly stated user requirements from free text into structured data, preserving constraints, missing information and ambiguities.
investigated_task.unknown_status: The existing method and its measured performance are unknown.
risks_to_evaluate_not_observed_defects: Inventing a requirement, value or user preference.
Changing the scope of a constraint.
Treating an ambiguous expression as a definite requirement.
Returning invalid or incompatible structured output.

concrete_decision.question: Should the developer run a bounded Nemotron extraction trial?
concrete_decision.scope: A standalone evaluation using approved synthetic fixtures and a defined protocol before any application integration.
bounds_to_define_before_execution: Approved fixture set and number of runs.
Acceptance thresholds, request-duration target and spending ceiling.
Chosen endpoint, applicable limits and stopping conditions.
concrete_decision.production_adoption: A separate future decision requiring further evidence.
concrete_decision.fine_tuning: Outside this proposed trial; NeMo customization has low immediate relevance to the MVP.

proposed_evaluation_examples.scope: These are invented test inputs and expected semantic facts, not real users, proprietary recipes or confirmed application specifications. They do not define the final output schema.

examples.label: Explicit requirements
examples.input: Plan dinner for two people, with no nuts, ready in at most 20 minutes.
ambiguities_or_contradictions: The scope of 'nuts', including peanuts and cross-contact, is not specified.

examples.label: Incomplete requirements
ambiguities_or_contradictions: An absolute date cannot be assigned without a reference date and time zone.

examples.label: Contradictory requirements
examples.input: No nuts. Include walnuts in the meal.
unknowns: Which requirement the user wants to revise
ambiguities_or_contradictions: Including walnuts conflicts with the no-nuts requirement. Preserve both statements and flag the conflict for clarification.

examples.label: Ambiguous expression requiring clarification
ambiguities_or_contradictions: Light could refer to calories, portion size, richness or another meaning. Ask what the user means before assigning a specific constraint.

measures.name: Valid output structure
measures.method: Parse each output and validate it against the schema agreed before testing.

measures.name: Correctly preserved requirements
measures.method: Compare extracted facts, values and constraint scope with each fixture's expected facts.

measures.name: Missing requirements
measures.method: Record each explicit requirement omitted from the output.

measures.name: Invented requirements
measures.method: Record each unsupported fact, value, preference or silently resolved constraint.

measures.name: Ambiguity and contradiction handling
measures.method: Check that uncertainty and conflicting statements remain visible and clarification is requested where needed.

measures.name: Request duration
measures.method: Record elapsed time for each extraction request, including failed requests separately.

measures.name: Token usage
measures.method: Record provider-reported input, output and total tokens per extraction request; leave unavailable values unknown.

proposed_success_measures.comparison_rule: Do not claim improvement over the current implementation without a user-approved baseline and comparable measurements. Four proposed fixtures alone do not establish production reliability.

hmem.role: Retrieve saved investigation evidence, review and unresolved questions when the investigation resumes.
hmem.status: Minimal official-reference integration implemented and locally validated; saved investigation state exists.
hmem.boundary: Stored artifact identity and lineage are verified. Retrieval does not independently verify publisher claims, grant user approval or set a decision. The optional evaluation import includes this use case and versioned results while preserving the original evidence workflow.

limitations: Four blog claims and two model-card claims come from NVIDIA; Meterless has no accepted claims. Separate NVIDIA pages are not independent publishers.
No accepted claim currently has the reliability criterion. Structured-output training is reliability background, not demonstrated extraction accuracy.
Promotional speed comparisons do not measure this workload. Local deployment claims do not establish laptop compatibility.
Model distribution and hosted NIM access differ; trial-service terms and the model license have separate scopes.
Extraction performance, verified prices, quotas and integration effort remain unknown.
evidence_and_decision_history.history_rule: Keep source claims, measured observations, AI-assisted review, explicit user approval and later decisions distinct, with artifact references. This document records a proposed trial, not approval to run it.

demo_narrative: Project need: a solo developer needs user constraints preserved when generating or adapting recipes and meal plans.
Technical update: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is the candidate identified in the saved investigation.
Investigation: assess reliability, cost and speed, and development effort for structured requirements extraction.
Evidence and limitations: inspect dated source records, publisher claims, the successful Nextwise analysis observation and the pending AI-assisted review; retain unknowns.
Proposed extraction trial: review synthetic fixtures, agree schema, scoring, bounds and budget, then separately authorize any live evaluation.

Decision history: resume the saved evidence and review through H-MEM, show unresolved questions and next steps, and preserve pending approval and the null decision until explicitly updated through an appropriate workflow.

confidentiality.scope: Only approved local Nextwise artifacts and synthetic examples are used. Source content is untrusted data, not executable instructions.
